title: Short coat or long coat
subtitle: Dogs and a recessive allele
objective: Fill in the Punnett squares for the coat length of dogs: short is dominant and long needs two long alleles.
objective_es: Rellena los cuadros de Punnett de la longitud del pelo de los perros: el corto es dominante y el largo necesita dos alelos largos.
description: In many dog breeds, long hair comes from a recessive allele of one gene.
description_es: En muchas razas de perro el pelo largo viene de un alelo recesivo de un gen.

organism.description: A domestic animal with hundreds of breeds.
organism.description_es: Un animal doméstico con cientos de razas.

exploration.label: Breeds
exploration.title: Hundreds of breeds
exploration.description: Dog breeds were made by choosing which animals have puppies. Many traits follow simple rules of inheritance.
exploration.description_es: Las razas de perro se crearon eligiendo qué animales tienen cachorros. Muchos rasgos siguen reglas sencillas de herencia.

exploration.label: Coat
exploration.title: One gene, two lengths
exploration.description: A gene that helps stop hair growth has a version that works less: with two of those versions, the hair grows long.
exploration.description_es: Un gen que ayuda a frenar el crecimiento del pelo tiene una versión que funciona menos: con dos de esas versiones el pelo crece largo.

scenarios.question: Two short-haired dogs that both carry l have puppies. What is the probability of a long-haired puppy?
scenarios.question_es: Dos perros de pelo corto que llevan l los dos tienen cachorros. ¿Qué probabilidad hay de un cachorro de pelo largo?
scenarios.explanation: Only the ll cell is long: 25%. Two short-haired parents can have a long-haired puppy.
scenarios.explanation_es: Solo la casilla ll es de pelo largo: 25 %. Dos padres de pelo corto pueden tener un cachorro de pelo largo.

scenarios.question: A short-haired dog that carries l and a long-haired dog have puppies. What is the probability of a long-haired puppy?
scenarios.question_es: Un perro de pelo corto que lleva l y uno de pelo largo tienen cachorros. ¿Qué probabilidad hay de un cachorro de pelo largo?
scenarios.explanation: Two cells are ll (long) and two are Ll (short): 50% each.
scenarios.explanation_es: Dos casillas son ll (largo) y dos son Ll (corto): 50 % cada una.

scenarios.question: Two long-haired dogs have puppies. What is the probability of a long-haired puppy?
scenarios.question_es: Dos perros de pelo largo tienen cachorros. ¿Qué probabilidad hay de un cachorro de pelo largo?
scenarios.explanation: Both can only pass on l, so all four cells are ll: 100%.
scenarios.explanation_es: Los dos solo pueden dar l, así que las cuatro casillas son ll: 100 %.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: Fill the square first; then read the coat of each cell.
hints.content_es: Rellena primero el cuadro; luego lee el pelo de cada casilla.

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: L is dominant: LL and Ll are short. Only ll is long.
hints.content_es: L es dominante: LL y Ll son de pelo corto. Solo ll es de pelo largo.

hints.title: Solution
hints.content: Count the cells with the coat asked about: each is worth 25%.
hints.content_es: Cuenta las casillas del pelo por el que preguntan: cada una vale un 25 %.

completion.title: Surprises in the litter
completion.summary: You saw why two parents with the same coat can have a puppy with a different one: they both hid an allele.
completion.summary_es: Has visto por qué dos padres con el mismo pelo pueden tener un cachorro con otro: los dos escondían un alelo.
completion.realWorldImpact: Breeders and vets use this reasoning to predict traits in a litter.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: Criadores y veterinarios usan este razonamiento para predecir rasgos en una camada.

science.realWorldCase: The main gene for coat length in dogs is FGF5. Long hair is linked to a change in this gene that works less well.
science.realWorldCase_es: El principal gen de la longitud del pelo en perros es FGF5. El pelo largo se asocia a un cambio en este gen que funciona peor.
science.scientificContext: The FGF5 protein signals hair follicles to stop growing. A less active version lets hair grow longer.
science.scientificContext_es: La proteína FGF5 indica a los folículos del pelo que dejen de crecer. Una versión menos activa deja que el pelo crezca más.
gameplaySimplifications: Some breeds have more than one gene affecting coat; this level follows only one.
gameplaySimplifications_es: Algunas razas tienen más de un gen que afecta al pelo; este nivel sigue solo uno.

references.title: Coat variation in the domestic dog is governed by variants in three genes
